researchNotes: LICENSING: data/licensed-institutions.json did not exist when this was written, so the SBV licence check could NOT be done; licensedInstitutionId 'techcombank' is unverified. GAPS: no official product page with a rate table (https://techcombank.com/khach-hang-ca-nhan/vay/vay-tieu-dung is a mainly secured consumer product up to 5 billion VND); no personal-loan fee schedule (biểu phí) or terms and conditions for unsecured loans found (only corporate/credit-card fee PDFs); no insurance, application/disbursement fee or late-penalty data; credit-card installment not researched. RATE DISCLOSURE: Techcombank publishes monthly average lending-rate PDFs (e.g. https://techcombank.com/content/dam/techcombank/public-site/documents/lai-suat-cho-vay-binh-quan-khcn-techcombank-thang-06-2026.pdf) and base-rate notices, but the PDF text could not be extracted, so no figure recorded. CONTRADICTIONS: amount (100M vs 400M vs 1B), term (20-36 vs 12-60), rate (1.2%/month vs 12.9%/year) across techcombank.com blog pages, which state they are compiled from general market info; several carry 'đã hết hạn' (expired) labels and publication dates differ from stated data dates (2025). SURPRISING: the only worked example has internal arithmetic errors. Treat all as medium/low confidence pending the contract or Techcombank Mobile disclosure.
